_comment: Zone configuration for A Gift for the Forgotten City. Loaded at runtime by game/js/world.js.

zones.name: The Sunken Library
zones.subtitle: A civilization of scholars lost beneath the waves
zones.lore: Once the greatest repository of knowledge on the continent, the Grand Library of Ael-Maris sank beneath a rising sea in a single night. Its scholars never escaped — but their writings did, sealed in waterproof vaults that still hum with forgotten wisdom.

zones.name: The Sky Nomads
zones.subtitle: Cloud cities that drifted away forever
zones.lore: The Aetheri built their homes on living cloudbanks, following seasonal winds across the sky. When the great storms came, their cloud platforms dispersed beyond the horizon — and were never found again. Only their crystalline waypoints remain, grounded and silent.

zones.name: The Deep Forge
zones.subtitle: Master craftsmen swallowed by the earth
zones.lore: The Khal-Drun were the finest smiths the world had ever known, working metals that no modern furnace can replicate. A catastrophic vein collapse buried their underground city in a single hour. The fires they lit still burn somewhere below — but no one knows how to reach them.

zones.name: The Memory Gardens
zones.subtitle: Spiritual keepers whose temples were silenced
zones.lore: The Seren were not warriors or builders — they were listeners. Their terraced gardens were places where the living spoke to the dead. When a plague swept through in a single season, there was no one left to tend the rites, and the voices of the departed fell silent forever.

zones.name: The Grand Reunion
zones.subtitle: Where all forgotten people finally meet
zones.lore: No civilization built this place. It exists only in the space between memories — a convergence point that appears when enough echoes have been returned. Here, the scholars, nomads, smiths, and spirit-keepers finally see each other for the first time. Here, the Gift is given.
